extracted.name: Shower Sherbet Punch
extracted.description: This sherbet punch recipe is super simple to make with pineapple sherbet, juice, and fizzy lemon-lime soda for a delicious drink perfect for showers.
instruction_lines: Scoop sherbet into a large punch bowl.
Pour soda and pineapple juice over sherbet. When adding soda, the punch will foam, so stir constantly so the foam can go down.
